Created by combining {{D|Cold}} and {{D|Toxin}} damage. {{D|Viral}} increases damage to health up to 325% with multiple stacks for a short duration.|In-game Description}} '''{{D|Viral}} Damage''' is one of the six secondary elemental damage types, composed of {{D|Cold}} and {{D|Toxin}} elements. Deals increased damage to {{D|Orokin}}, but reduced damage to {{D|Infested Deimos}} and {{D|The Murmur}}, with some Deimos units being outright immune. Its [[Status Effect]] increases damage dealt to [[Health]]. ==[[Status Effect]]== ===General=== The status effect of {{D|Viral}} damage is '''Virus'''. It amplifies damage to the [[health]] of the afflicted target by '''100%''' for '''6''' seconds. Subsequent procs add '''25%''' increased damage to health up to '''325%''' in total after '''10''' stacks, with each stack having their own duration. Any stacks applied after the 10th will replace the oldest stack. This effect will work even when the health is protected by [[armor]] ("yellow health"); only [[shield]]s and [[overguard]]s are not affected. { \begin{aligned} \text{Resultant Damage to Health} &= \text{Modded Damage} \times [2 + (0.25 \times (\text{Number of Viral Stacks} - 1) ) ] \end{aligned} } ::''Calculating resultant damage if at least one Viral proc is on target. [[Damage Vulnerability]] provided by Viral procs are multiplicative with other damage bonuses.'' For status effects that apply damage over time (e.g. {{D|Slash}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Gas}}), the damage dealt by the proc throughout its duration is calculated based on whether or not a {{D|Viral}} proc is active when the DoT tick deals damage. For example, a weapon with 100 damage that applies a {{D|Slash}} proc, if the target has 1 {{D|Viral}} proc, will deal 200 damage, then '''70''' damage per second from {{D|Slash}}'s '''Bleed''' until the {{D|Viral}} effect ends, when it will go down to '''35''' per second. If the target does not have a {{D|Viral}} proc initially, the '''Bleed''' damage will be '''35''' per second until the target takes a {{D|Viral}} proc, which will then multiply the DoT accordingly to '''70''' per second. This means that the multiplier is ''not'' applied twice to DoTs, unlike [[Faction Damage Mods|faction damage multipliers]]. Attacks deal their initial damage ''before'' they apply {{D|Viral}} status effects to the target, and therefore do not increase their own damage. For example, a weapon that procs {{D|Viral}} on its second hit will only deal increased damage from the third hit onwards. * [[Multishot]] hits of the same shot do '''not''' benefit from each other's {{D|Viral}} procs. * Individual shots in an Instant Burst (such as the {{Weapon|Quartakk}}) '''do''' benefit from the {{D|Viral}} procs caused by previous shots in the same Instant Burst, despite the lack of delay. * {{D|Electricity}} and {{D|Gas}} procs created at the same time as {{D|Viral}} procs '''do''' have the damage of their first tick amplified, despite it occurring immediately. informal explanation for any editors trying to improve wording events in the same line occur in the same game tick derived from damage numbers in simulacrum A) Shot 1: 100 damage -> enemy takes 100 damage Shot 2: 100 damage and viral proc -> enemy takes 100 damage -> enemy gets 1 viral Shot 3: 100 damage -> enemy takes 100*2=200 damage B) Shot 1: Multishot of [25 damage, 25 damage and viral proc, 25 damage, 25 damage] -> enemy takes 25 + 25 + 25 + 25 damage -> enemy gets 1 viral Shot 2: Multishot of [25 damage, 25 damage, 25 damage, 25 damage] -> enemy takes 25*2 + 25*2 + 25*2 + 25*2 = 50 + 50 + 50 + 50 damage C) Quartakk fires instant Burst: Shot 1: 25 damage, shot 2: 25 damage and 1 viral, shot 3: 25 damage, shot 4: 25 damage -> enemy takes 25 damage -> enemy takes 25 damage -> enemy gets 1 viral -> enemy takes 25*2=50 damage -> enemy takes 25*2=50 damage D) Viral-modded Hysterix Electric Quill: Shot 1: [100 base +<60 toxin + 60 cold = 120 viral>] damage and electric proc -> enemy takes [100 + 120 = 220] damage -> enemy gets 1 electric proc [100 base / 2 = 50 damage/tick] -> electric tick happens immediately -> enemy takes 50 damage next electric tick happens a second later -> enemy takes 50 damage etc Shot 2: [100 base + <60 toxin + 60 cold = 120 viral>] damage, electric proc and viral proc -> enemy takes [100 + 120 = 220] damage -> enemy gets 1 viral and 1 electric proc [100 base / 2 = 50 damage/tick] -> electric tick happens immediately -> enemy takes 50*2 = 100 damage next electric tick happens a second later -> enemy takes 50*2 = 100 damage etc --> Enemies afflicted by a {{D|Viral}} proc are coated in a flowing, leaking miasma of the Energy color of the weapon that inflicted it. *The following enemies are immune to {{D|Viral}} status: **[[Ambulas]] **[[Deimos Carnis]] Now it deals 2x Damage to Health, and can scale up to 4.5x Damage on repeat Status Effects.'' {{ver|11}} *Introduced. }} ==See Also== *[[Blight]] {{DamageNav}} [[es:Daño Viral]] [[fr:Dégâts/Dégâts Viral]] [[ru:Урон/Вирус]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Viral Damage}}

{{Infobox | Box title = Void Damage | image = EssentialVoidGlyph.png | Row 1 title = Icon | Row 1 info = [[File:VoidTearIcon_b.png|32px|class=icon]] [[File:VoidTearIcon_w.png|32px|class=icon]] }} {{Quote|'''DAMAGE EFFICACY'''
'''{{text|green|x1.5}}''' damage to Zariman '''STATUS EFFECT'''
Highly effective against enemies with Overguard Health and Sentients as it resets their damage adaptation. {{D|Void}} creates a bullet attractor sphere on the target that attracts and concentrates further attacks.|In-Game Description}} '''{{D|Void}} Damage''' is a special damage type that is almost exclusive to [[Operator]]s, their [[Amp]]s, and {{WF|Xaku}}. Deals increased damage to {{D|Overguard}} and {{D|Zariman}} Void manifestations, but is otherwise neutral to all other health types meaning its damage is neither increased or decreased against most targets. Its [[Status Effect]] creates a field on the target that attracts bullets. {{D|Void}} damage also provides unique advantages and uses, most notably against {{Faction|Sentient}} enemies (with the exception of Xaku's abilities): *Guarantees a stun against drone-type Sentients like [[Battalyst]]s and [[Conculyst]]s. *Nullifies any damage resistance developed by drone-type Sentients and the [[Shadow Stalker]]. *Bypasses certain invulnerabilities possessed by [[Eidolon]]-type Sentient like the [[Eidolon Vomvalyst]], [[Eidolon Teralyst]], and the [[Ropalolyst]]. *Destroy [[Kuva]] clouds in [[Kuva Siphon]] missions. *Force [[Profit-Taker Orb]]'s shields to adopt another damage type weakness. *Opens the [[Corpus Gas City#Secret Laboratories|Secret Laboratory]] doors in the [[Corpus Gas City]]. *Activate a [[Cambion Drift#Requiem Obelisk|Requiem Obelisk]] in the [[Cambion Drift]]. *Properly open an [[Isolation Vault]] in the Cambion Drift. **Restore [[Loid]] and [[Otak]]'s health. *Seal Void Rifts in [[Void Cascade]]. *Kill the [[Thrax Centurion]]'s and [[Thrax Legatus]]' spectral forms. *Kill the [[Void Angel]]'s Ethereal form. ==[[Status Effect]]s== The Status Effect of {{D|Void}} damage is '''Bullet Attractor''', which creates a small '''2.5''' meter radius field centered on where the target was shot for '''3''' seconds (e.g. proccing {{D|Void}} on the target's head creates the Bullet Attractor field centered on their head, proccing on their feet centers the field on their feet). Hit-scan bullets and projectiles that are shot into the field will be redirected towards the target. If the projectile has [[Punch Through]], the projectile will "orbit" in the field after hitting the main target, making them unlikely to hit the main target more than once. As such, the attractor is not as synergistic with Punch Through as the similar {{A|Magnetize}}, though tightly packed enemies can be damaged by the orbiting projectiles. If the status effect expires while projectiles are still in the field, they will shoot out in effectively random directions and might hit more enemies. Afflicted enemies will also have their own projectiles redirected, preventing them from properly shooting the player. ==Void Sources== *{{D|Void}} damage can be found in the [[Operator]]'s Void powers, which include: **[[Void Beam]]/[[Amp]] (Operator attack) **[[Void Sling]] *{{D|Void}} damage is part of Warframe {{WF|Xaku}}'s Abilities: **{{A|Xata's Whisper}} ([[Helminth]] subsumable) **{{A|Grasp of Lohk}} **{{A|The Lost}} (Deny sub-ability) **{{A|The Vast Untime}} *{{M|Astral Bond}} allows [[Companion]]s to deal {{D|Void}} damage. *{{Resource|Nonono}} {{DamageTypeTable|Void}} ==Notes== *{{D|Void}} damage is neither physical nor elemental; as such it receives no increases from {{Focus|Madurai}}'s {{Focus|Phoenix Talons}} and conversely it receives no penalties against resistances generated from [[Sortie]] conditions (Physical or Elemental Enhancements). *{{WF|Xaku}}'s {{D|Void}} damage is only capable of proccing its Bullet Attractor status and resetting Sentient resistances, and only {{A|Xata's Whisper}} and {{A|The Lost}}'s Deny can do this. It lacks all other benefits, including bypassing [[Eidolon]]-type Sentient invulnerabilities and changing [[Profit-Taker Orb]]'s shield weakness. However, all its abilities still deal bonus damage to {{D|Overguard}} and {{D|Zariman}}. ==Media== Screenshot_519.png|An enemy affected by a void proc ==Trivia== *{{D|Void}} damage was originally a placeholder type added in {{ver|18}}, before being formally named in {{ver|22}} with the inclusion of [[The Quills]] and [[Amp]]s. ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|42}} *Added a new Void icon beside healthbars that require Void damage to destroy (ex: spectral versions of Vomvalysts, Eidolon shields, etc.). **We introduced this with Hunhullus’ vulnerability to Void damage in The Old Peace and are now applying it to all other enemies and bosses. {{ver|36}} *Added a Void Damage tooltip in the Operator stats UI to show its efficacy stat and Status Effect description. **Now reads: “Damage Efficacy: X damage to Zariman. **:Status Effect: Highly effective against enemies with Overguard Health and Sentients as it resets their damage adaptation. Void creates a bullet attractor sphere on the target that attracts and concentrates further attacks.”. {{ver|29.5}} *Void damage’s Status Effect will now redirect projectiles to the body part it proc’d on. **'''How it will work:''' If you shoot at an enemy’s head with Xata’s Whisper enabled and proc, the bubble will redirect all projectiles to the head. If you shoot at the feet, it’ll be redirected to the feet, etc.! It is however possible that even if you proc on the head but then shoot at the lower part of the bubble it might hit the body on the way up to being redirected to the head. **This is a game wide change to Void Status Effect! Now that we have a Warframe that can harness Void damage at the click of a button, it has brought much focus to and discussion around its Status Effect. For those of you who are unfamiliar, in its current state it creates a bullet attractor bubble that directs all projectiles to the center of the enemy’s torso regardless of where it procs. Since Xata’s Whisper applies Void damage to all of their weapons, it was increasingly noticeable to Xaku players that the bubble’s '''current redirecting position prevents any attempt at enemy headshots until its duration expires.''' This is one of the main reasons for this change. Headshot disruption ultimately limits your damage output by removing the opportunity for headshot multipliers while it is active. Now, you will be able to use your headshotting skills to greater benefit, while also having generally more options to focus projectiles where desired. Note that regardless of where the Status Effect occurs, it will continue to prevent enemies from being able to shoot at you without having their projectiles redirected back to the center of the bubble. {{ver|29.1}} *We are making Void damage ‘True Neutral’ by removing the 50% resistance of Void damage on Cloned Flesh and Fossilized enemies - a long desired request for Void damage. **Currently, Void damage is relatively ineffective against Cloned Flesh and Fossilized enemies which greatly limits the use of Xata’s Whisper on Grineer and Infested enemies. In an effort to give it (and Void damage in general) more utility across enemy categories, we are removing this resistance so that it aligns with its neutral effectiveness against the other enemy types. It is important to note that Eidolons, Amalgams, and certain bosses will still maintain this resistance. {{ver|22}} *Introduced. }} {{DamageNav}} [[es:Daño Vacío]] [[fr:Dégâts Néant]] [[ru:Урон/Бездна]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Void Damage}} [[Category:Operator]] [[Category:Update 22]] [[Category:Mechanics]] [[Category:Damage 3.0]] [[Category:Damage]]

'''Dera Incarnon Genesis''' is an item that is used to add [[Incarnon]] upgrades to the {{Weapon|Dera}} or {{Weapon|Dera Vandal}}.

==Acquisition==
*Upon completion of [[The Duviri Paradox]] and [[Angels of the Zariman]], and unlocking [[The Steel Path]], players can earn {{Resource|Dera Incarnon Genesis}} from [[The Circuit]]'s Steel Path to place on their Dera with the help of [[Cavalero]] in the [[Chrysalith]]. This [[Incarnon Genesis]] form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
*Purchased from Cavalero for {{pc|120}}, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made '''once'''.

==Incarnon Genesis==

* Installing the Dera Incarnon Genesis requires 20 {{Resource|Pathos Clamp|Pathos Clamps}}, 80 {{Resource|Eevani}}, and 70 {{Resource|Ueymag}}.
** When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 [[affinity]] to the weapon, affected by [[Affinity Booster]]s.

===Overview===
* Incarnon Form is charged by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving [[Enemy Body Parts|weakpoint hits]] and then pressing the [[Alternate Fire]] button. '''25''' weakpoints hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form.
**Charges '''do''' generate when hitting weak points highlighted by {{A|Sonar}} or {{M|Detect Vulnerability}}. 
***However, they do not generate from hits on {{A|Crystallize}}'s crystalline growths.
** Weakpoints on corpses or [[Invulnerable]] targets do '''not''' build charges.
** Individual [[Multishot]] bullets can build charges.
* Mode switching is '''not''' instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's [[reload speed]].
* Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
* Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Dera's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing '''2''' rounds to a maximum of '''50'''. Once all ammunition is expended, the Dera reverts to its normal form.
** Incarnon Form's magazine is '''not''' affected by mods.
** Incarnon Form is '''not''' affected by [[Ammo Efficiency]] (such as {{A|Energized Munitions}}).
** Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, [[bleedout]], or being [[disarm|disarmed]]. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon [[death]].
